summary: Harden profile principal URI set, RFC 6901 index digits, ancestor symlinks, and regex anchors

No breaking changes to valid authority grants or profiles

architecture.decision: Guard profile executor/issuer/revoker URI comparison with _principal_uri, bound parse_array_index token length before int(), enforce lstat+fstat inode stability and relative ancestor symlink checks, and anchor all authority regexes with \Z.
